subject: general
question: Which of the following days marked the 17th Foundation Day of the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights?
solution:
The correct answer is **"__1 March 2022__".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• At the Red Fort's 15th August Ground in New Delhi, the **National Commission for the Protection of Children's Rights (NCPCR) commemorated its 17th anniversary on 1st march 2022.**
 
• The occasion was **attended by the Chairperson of the NCPCR, Shri Priyank Kanoongo, the Secretary of the WCD, Shri Indevar Pandey, **and other officials.
 
• The major guest was the **Union Minister for Women and Child Development, Smt. Smriti Zubin Irani.** "The **new slogan exhorts us to protect the future**, i.e. **our children, for in their wellbeing lies the foundation of a strong Nation**," Smt. Irani stated at the event as she unveiled the NCPCR's new motto.
 
• The Minister talked with kids from several States and went to an exhibition about **young freedom warriors** that was put on by the Border Security Forces (BSF) in association with NCPCR to honour their sacrifices.
